meta.challenge: Be An Earth System Trend Detective!
meta.confidence_note: Displayed confidence = (1 − p) × 100, using the Hamed-Rao corrected p-value. This is a frequentist confidence approximation used as a plain-language label. It is not a computed Bayesian posterior probability.
meta.dataset: NASA POWER (Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources)
meta.method: Mann-Kendall trend test (two-sided) with Sen's slope, Hamed-Rao (1998) modified variance and Yue-Pilon pre-whitening autocorrelation corrections
meta.status: STARTER FILE — numbers taken from the locked plan (trend-court-winning-plan). Replace with Member 1's frozen trends.json, including the full annual series and change-point test output, before submission. No number may be added here that was not tested and recorded.

not_tested_message: Not tested — Trend Court only reports trends that were tested and recorded in trends.json. It never generates an estimate for a place, variable or period that was not tested.
